description: End-to-end workflow for assuring, orchestrating, and tracking customer device swap operations in a telecom-as-a-service (TaaS Camara) environment, including eligibility checks, configuration planning, execution, monitoring, rollback, and closure.

swap_request_id.description: Unique identifier for a device swap request lifecycle.

customer_id.description: Unique identifier for the customer in the operator or partner system.

device_id.description: Identifier of a physical device (IMEI, serial, or inventory ID).

subscription_id.description: Identifier of the telco subscription, line, or SIM associated with the device.

network_session_id.description: Identifier for a network/data session related to the device.

correlation_id.description: Correlation ID provided by client to trace all operations in external systems.

actor_ref.description: Reference to the actor (human user or system) performing an action.

attachment_ref.description: Attachment reference: file or external link.

tag_filter.description: Tag-based filter with key/value match and operators.

functions.name: check_swap_eligibility
functions.description: Validate if a customer and target device are eligible for a swap, including contract, technical, and policy constraints.

current_device.description: Information about the device currently in use.

imei.description: IMEI of the current device, if available.

capabilities.description: Detected capabilities of the current device.

target_device.description: Information about the device that will replace the current device.

device_id.description: Target device identifier from inventory or catalog.

imei.description: IMEI of the target device, if already known.

capability_requirements.description: Required capabilities that must be supported by the network and subscription after swap.

subscription_id.description: Subscription that will be bound to the target device.

policy_context.description: Context for applying business and technical policies.

correlation_id.description: Optional client correlation ID for tracing.

functions.returns: Eligibility result with decision, blocking reasons if any, and recommended configuration profile.

functions.name: create_swap_request
functions.description: Create a new device swap request and capture initial configuration and policy decisions.

subscription_id.description: Subscription to be re-associated with the new device.

requested_swap_window.description: Preferred time window for executing the swap.

service_profile.description: Initial desired service profile after swap.

items.description: Region code or roaming zone identifier.

notification_preferences.description: How and when to notify customer about swap progress.

functions.returns: New swap_request_id with initial status, snapshot of current/target device binding, and planned execution window.

functions.name: get_swap_request
functions.description: Retrieve full details and current status of a specific swap request.

include.description: Additional sections of the swap to include.

functions.returns: Swap request details, including lifecycle state, configuration, and execution history if requested.

functions.name: list_swap_requests
functions.description: List and filter device swap requests for a customer, subscription, or across the system for monitoring.
functions.returns: Paginated list of swap requests matching the filters, with summary status and key attributes.

functions.name: plan_swap_configuration
functions.description: Generate a detailed network and service configuration plan for the device swap, including rollback options.

policy_overrides.description: Optional overrides for specific policy keys.

network_constraints.description: Constraints from the operator network to consider in planning.

maintenance_windows.description: Planned maintenance windows to avoid for swap execution.

rollback_preferences.description: Preferences for how and when rollback should be allowed.

rollback_timeout_seconds.description: Time window after activation during which automatic rollback is allowed.

functions.returns: Planned configuration steps, dependency graph, and rollback strategy for the swap request.

functions.name: start_swap_execution
functions.description: Begin executing the planned device swap, including deactivating the old device and preparing the new one.

pre_execution_checks.description: Extra lightweight checks to perform just before execution.

risk_acceptance.description: Indicates whether known non-blocking risks are accepted.

items.description: Risk code previously reported in planning or eligibility.

accepted_by.description: Identifier of the actor that accepted the risks.

functions.returns: Confirmation that swap execution has started or queued, with initial execution state and estimated completion time.

functions.name: get_swap_status
functions.description: Check detailed execution status and health of a device swap in progress or completed.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request ID whose status is being queried.

include_subtasks.description: Whether to include individual network/configuration actions.

include_metrics.description: Include performance and SLA metrics if available.

functions.returns: Current lifecycle status of the swap, subtask progress, and any detected issues or SLA metrics.

functions.name: verify_post_swap_service
functions.description: Run post-swap service assurance checks such as connectivity tests, reachability, and QoS verification.

validation_profile.description: Tests to perform after the swap.

application_probes.description: Application-level probes to run on the target device network path.

network_session_hint.description: Optional hint about the new network session to check.

functions.returns: Post-swap service verification report, including pass/fail for each test and suggested remediation steps if needed.

functions.name: retry_swap_step
functions.description: Retry a failed step or subtask within a swap execution with optional parameter overrides.

swap_request_id.description: Swap request containing the failed step.

step_id.description: Identifier of the specific step or network action to retry.

override_parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides for this retry attempt.

items.description: List of allowed cell IDs to target during reconfiguration.

retry_reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the retry is being triggered.

functions.returns: Status of the retry initiation and updated step state, including a new attempt ID if applicable.

functions.name: rollback_swap
functions.description: Rollback a partially or fully executed swap back to the original device and configuration when possible.

constraints.description: Constraints that may limit rollback behavior.

dry_run.description: If true, only simulate rollback impacts without executing changes.

functions.returns: Rollback plan and status, including whether rollback was executed, simulated only, or blocked by constraints.

functions.name: cancel_swap_request
functions.description: Cancel a pending or in-progress swap request if it is still eligible for cancellation.

preserve_partial_changes.description: If true, do not attempt rollback, only stop further actions.

functions.returns: Cancellation confirmation with final status, whether any rollback was triggered, and next actions if needed.

functions.name: close_swap_with_assurance
functions.description: Formally close a completed swap after verifying service assurance metrics and recording final outcome.

assurance_summary.description: Summary of assurance metrics and test results supporting closure.

open_issues.description: Outstanding issues that remain after swap closure.

customer_confirmation.description: Information on whether the customer has confirmed successful swap.

functions.returns: Finalized swap record with closure status, assurance results, and whether any follow-up actions were scheduled.

functions.name: search_device_swap_entities
functions.description: Faceted search across device_swap entities supporting tag filters, time windows, full-text, status, and pagination.

projection.description: Optional list of fields to project in the response.

functions.returns: Paginated list of matching device_swap entities, optional facet counts, and pagination cursors.

functions.name: bulk_create_device_swap_records
functions.description: Bulk-create up to N device_swap records in a single atomic-or-best-effort batch with per-item validation results.
functions.returns: Per-record outcome with assigned ids or validation errors, plus an overall batch summary.

functions.name: bulk_update_device_swap_records
functions.description: Apply a partial update patch to many device_swap records, optionally with optimistic concurrency checks.
functions.returns: Per-update result with new version ids and a count of successes/failures.

functions.name: bulk_delete_device_swap_records
functions.description: Delete or soft-delete many device_swap records in one call, with cascade and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Per-id deletion outcome and references to any cascaded entities.

functions.name: export_device_swap_dataset
functions.description: Schedule or stream an export of device_swap data to CSV/JSONL/Parquet, with field selection and filters.
functions.returns: Export job id, estimated row count, and status tracking endpoint.

functions.name: import_device_swap_dataset
functions.description: Validate and import a device_swap dataset from a remote URI; supports dry-run and conflict handling.

mapping.description: Source column to target field mapping.

functions.returns: Import job id, row counts (succeeded/failed/skipped), and a sample of validation errors.

functions.name: snapshot_device_swap_state
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of one or more device_swap entities for later restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot id, size estimate, and retention expiry timestamp.

functions.name: restore_device_swap_snapshot
functions.description: Restore device_swap state from a prior snapshot with dry-run preview and conflict resolution.
functions.returns: Restore plan or actual restore result with per-entity status.

functions.name: get_device_swap_metrics
functions.description: Query aggregated metrics/KPIs for the device_swap workflow with grouping, filters, and time ranges.
functions.returns: Time-series points per metric and group, with totals and percentiles.

functions.name: build_device_swap_dashboard
functions.description: Compose a dashboard view across device_swap metrics, with panels, filters, and a shareable link.
functions.returns: Dashboard id, share URL, and resolved layout metadata.

functions.name: query_device_swap_audit_events
functions.description: Search the device_swap audit/change log with filters across actors, actions, resources, and time windows.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events with optional before/after diffs.

functions.name: subscribe_device_swap_events
functions.description: Create a webhook subscription that delivers device_swap workflow events to a target URL with retries and signing.
functions.returns: Subscription id, verification challenge if applicable, and active flag.

functions.name: list_device_swap_subscriptions
functions.description: List webhook subscriptions for device_swap events with filters and status counts.
functions.returns: Paginated list of subscriptions with last delivery status.

functions.name: delete_device_swap_subscription
functions.description: Remove a webhook subscription for device_swap events.
functions.returns: Confirmation with final delivery counters.

functions.name: schedule_device_swap_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring or one-off device_swap job (cron/rrule/interval) with arguments and an owner.
functions.returns: Schedule id and next computed run time.

functions.name: list_device_swap_schedules
functions.description: List scheduled device_swap jobs with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of schedules with last/next run timestamps.

functions.name: cancel_device_swap_schedule
functions.description: Cancel or pause a scheduled device_swap job.
functions.returns: Updated schedule state.

functions.name: simulate_device_swap_operation
functions.description: Run a what-if simulation of a device_swap operation without committing side effects, returning predicted outcomes.
functions.returns: Predicted outcomes, side-effect summary, warnings, and policy hits.

functions.name: request_device_swap_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a device_swap action, routing to the right approvers and policies.
functions.returns: Approval request id, routed approver list, and SLA timer.

functions.name: decide_device_swap_approval
functions.description: Record an approve/reject/abstain decision on a device_swap approval request with required justification.
functions.returns: Updated approval state and downstream effects (e.g., gate releases).

functions.name: add_device_swap_comment
functions.description: Add a threaded comment or annotation to any device_swap entity, supporting mentions and attachments.
functions.returns: Comment id, thread id, and updated thread state.

functions.name: list_device_swap_comments
functions.description: List comments/annotations attached to a device_swap entity with pagination and filters.
functions.returns: Paginated comment threads with author/timestamp/mentions.

functions.name: upsert_device_swap_policy
functions.description: Create or update a policy/rule controlling device_swap behavior, with conditions, effects, and a priority.
functions.returns: Policy id, version, and any conflicts with existing policies.

functions.name: list_device_swap_policies
functions.description: List device_swap policies/rules with filters and active flags.
functions.returns: Paginated list of policies with priority and last-modified info.

functions.name: link_device_swap_entities
functions.description: Create a typed relationship between two device_swap-related entities (parent/child, depends_on, references).
functions.returns: Link id and a graph delta showing newly-created relationships.

functions.name: get_device_swap_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency/relationship graph rooted at a device_swap entity, up to N hops, with cycle detection.
functions.returns: Nodes/edges of the dependency graph and any cycles detected.

functions.name: tag_device_swap_entities
functions.description: Add, remove, or replace tags on one or many device_swap entities.
functions.returns: Updated tag set per entity and count of changes applied.

functions.name: attach_device_swap_evidence
functions.description: Upload or link an evidence artifact (log, screenshot, document) to a device_swap entity for traceability.
functions.returns: Attachment id, sensitivity classification, and storage URI.
